reason: Real, with a corrected framing. field_meta.as_of is by design the yfinance info fetch time (FieldMeta docstring; _served_field_meta stamps one fetched_at on every field), so it is not mislabelled so much as the payload has no reporting-period date for any value. The smallest fix is a per-field period on the fields that have one, plus a short-history flag on 52w when the first trade falls within the last 365 days.
